capabilities: export the current Canvas to a single offline HTML file
search exported HTML with highlighting and card navigation
filter cards by badges and inline custom field annotations
read card contents in a reflowable side panel
add a title, author, timestamp, and background watermark to exports
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or later; file cards, web cards, embedded notes, PDFs, and remote images become placeholders in exports. No network access or account needed. Older exports must be re-exported to gain newer viewer features.
problem: Obsidian Canvas files can only be viewed inside Obsidian, so canvases cannot be shared as standalone, viewable documents with people who don't use the app.

relations.evidence: Existing standard span.badge markup works even without SimpleBadge installed, using the exporter's built-in fallback styling.

summary: Exports an Obsidian Canvas to a single standalone HTML file that preserves card layout and adds offline search, reading, and filters.
